exposure: Maternal symptomatic or asymptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection
cohort: 407 infants born to mothers from a single-site prospective cross-sectional study (COVID-19 Mother Baby Outcomes [COMBO] Initiative) of mother-infant dyads and a multisite prospective cohort study (Epidemiology of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 in Pregnancy and Infancy [ESPI]) of pregnant individuals
finding: Maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy was not associated with differences in cognitive, gross motor, fine motor, expressive language, or receptive language DAYC-2 subdomain scores
